name: chicken-eggs
comment: WP-2.3 task 1. Three chickens (ids 0-2) in the fenced stone pen of entity/sheep-shear for 7300 ticks, no player. The constructor's egg timer rand.nextInt(6000) + 6000 (EntityChicken.java:17) is drawn on the unseeded rand in vanilla; the oracle redraws it on the seeded stream at the join (HarnessWorld.seedOnJoin), which the port's seeded constructor reproduces: 6782, 6265 and 7247 ticks for ids 0, 1, 2. At 0 the chicken plays mob.chickenplop (two rand draws), drops an egg item (344) at its feet (Entity.dropItem) and draws a new timer (EntityChicken.java:43-47). The wandering (EntityCreature.updatePlayerActionState, the pathfinder) runs all along. rng_state every 10 ticks, entity_state every 100 ticks and on the ticks around each egg.
